title: aphanes floribunda
intro: Aphanes floribunda, commonly known as lady's mantle or buckthorn flower, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from gastrointestinal issues, menstrual cramps, and skin irritations. The health benefits of Aphanes floribunda are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
